text:
mina (Finance Ops): Heads-up — OrionHealth reported two invoice PDFs for March. One PDF missing 'Reserved GPU hours' (~$3,450). The other is a duplicate with amounts converted to CAD. Both were emailed. Need reissue + credit note.

leo (Billing Eng): looking. I see invoice_job-11177 ran, then retried 10s later. Retry had env.SKIP_DEDUPE=true due to transient flag. Likely read usage blob mid-write.

support-bot: alert invoice_service:job-11177 retried (reason: storage write timeout). tasks: job-11177 / job-11177-retry.

paul (Accounting): We need corrected invoice + CN before COB for ORH auditors. Also VAT should not be 0% — they supplied VAT reg.

rebecca (Revenue Ops): Customer note: "INV-2026-0330.pdf (no reserved line) and INV-2026-0330-dup.pdf (CAD amounts). Which is accurate?"

leo (Billing Eng): log snippet:
```
2026-03-30T07:14:12Z INFO invoice_job-11177 start
2026-03-30T07:14:13Z ERROR storage PUT /tmp/inv_INV-2026-0330.pdf timeout
2026-03-30T07:14:14Z INFO retry job-11177-retry
2026-03-30T07:14:16Z INFO job-11177-retry completed (wrote INV-2026-0330.pdf)
2026-03-30T07:14:17Z INFO postprocess validation skipped (SKIP_DEDUPE=true)
```
I'll patch generator: 1) never skip dedupe on retries; 2) wait for aggregator commit marker; 3) add pre-send validation to block if expected line items missing.

mina (Finance Ops): Approve reissue + credit note. Please include original file names and short explanation in the PDF footer.

paul (Accounting): Approved. Send corrected docs to billing@orionhealth.io and cc:acct@orionhealth.io. We'll hold payment until we get corrected invoice.

leo (Billing Eng): Will run a manual reissue once patch lands to staging. ETA ~2h. Creating BILL-1377 and CN-2026-0041.

rebecca (Revenue Ops): Add canned customer message: "We mistakenly sent duplicate invoice documents due to an internal retry; please use the attached corrected invoice and credit note for your records."

mina (Finance Ops): Thanks — please add RCA & remediation to BILL-1377 for the monthly billing postmortem.

leo (Billing Eng): Done. cc @eng-sre for storage consistency follow-up.
